name: Remove Legacy Microsoft Apps Pack
description: Removes selected older or unnecessary preinstalled Microsoft apps from Windows to reduce clutter and free up storage space.

description_i18n.en: Removes selected older or unnecessary preinstalled Microsoft apps from Windows to reduce clutter and free up storage space.
description_i18n.de: Entfernt ausgewählte ältere oder unnötige vorinstallierte Microsoft-Apps aus Windows, um Ballast zu reduzieren und Speicherplatz freizugeben.
description_i18n.fr: Supprime une sélection d'applications Microsoft préinstallées obsolètes ou inutiles de Windows pour réduire l'encombrement et libérer de l'espace.

warnings.title: App removal is permanent
warnings.message: Removed applications cannot be restored by this tool. Windows Store apps may need to be reinstalled manually if needed later

warnings.title: Registry change
warnings.message: Persistent Windows settings may change until the tweak is restored

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Removes installed and provisioned Appx packages matching the selected filter (Maps, Mixed Reality, or specific utilities) The tweak updates a registry marker to track enabled state
